card.name: Fractions and ratios in strengths
card.fires_on: Pieces inside written fractions, ratios and strength phrases, such as the digit in 1:1000, M/6, 1/2 normal saline, or 'one-half' tablets. It fires partway through the expression, before it is complete.

modes.label: Ratio or fraction digits
modes.description: A digit or slash inside a ratio or fraction describing a solution strength.

modes.label: Half-strength and tablet counts
modes.description: Words or a closing parenthesis within phrases giving a fractional or counted amount of tablets.
modes.example: is 750 mg (one and<< one>>-half tablets) of naproxen tablets

modes.label: Rates with per
modes.description: The word per in an incidence rate such as 1 case per 250,000.

card.plain: It marks the middle of a written fraction or ratio, like 1:1000 or one-half strength, where the rest of the amount is still to come.
